label: FP
reason: The reported XSS finding is a False Positive. Although user input flows from getQueryString() to the response writer, the data passes through org.apache.commons.lang.StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml() (Lines 77-80) before reaching the sink. This function escapes '<', '>', '&', preventing HTML/script injection. While a separate Format String Vulnerability (tainted-format-string) exists due to unescaped '%' characters in the format string, the specific XSS threat is mitigated.

evidence.note: User input 'param' is passed to doSomething() which applies StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml() to sanitize HTML special characters before writing to response.
Sink: response.getWriter().format(bar, obj) writes the sanitized string 'bar'. Since 'bar' is HTML-escaped, XSS payloads are neutralized.
